title: Please rethink this and watch the profits peak
body: From a product and UX perspective, this app would be amazing with a free trial that lets users experience its core value before committing to a subscription. A slight price reduction could also make it much more accessible and improve overall adoption and conversion. Just a thought from a developer’s perspective.
author: Forjestudio

title: Not so great app.
body: This would’ve been a great app, if only the app has a free trial before a full subscription payment.
author: GoofyAce31

title: Cost
body: Love the app, I just don’t see myself paying that much tbh. There are cheaper apps with less interesting interface but still serves the goal so I think I’ll find a free one. It was nice though!
author: Coucou belle
